campus-arrival.text: The university campus was filled with students. You walked towards your classroom, hoping the day would go smoothly.

campus-petals.text: Cherry blossoms drifted across the path. Somewhere beyond the courtyard, someone was playing a familiar song.

familiar-face.text: Suddenly, you noticed a familiar face standing near the university entrance.

gabriel-hello.speaker: gabriel
gabriel-hello.text: Hey! Were you waiting for me?

campus-choice.speaker: gabriel
campus-choice.text: That little smile. You’ve known it since you were kids. Somehow, it still catches you off guard.

options.text: Obviously! Who else would I wait for?
I just happened to be here.

campus-warm.speaker: gabriel
campus-warm.text: Well... good. Because I was hoping you would be, {playerName}.

campus-tease.speaker: gabriel
campus-tease.text: There it is. That’s the {playerName} I know. I’d be worried if you stopped teasing me.

campus-chance.speaker: gabriel
campus-chance.text: Then I guess it’s my lucky day. I’m glad I happened to be here, too.

campus-leave.text: He falls into step beside you, close enough that your sleeves brush. Neither of you moves away.

garden-invite.speaker: gabriel
garden-invite.text: Come on, let’s take a walk. I have something to tell you.

garden-bench.speaker: gabriel
garden-bench.text: Do you remember that summer we tried to build a boat? You said we’d sail somewhere no one could find us.

garden-choice.speaker: player
garden-choice.text: You remember the crooked little boat, the sea, and a promise made with sandy hands.

options.text: I’d still go anywhere with you.
Only if you build a better boat this time.

garden-together.speaker: gabriel
garden-together.text: You can’t just say things like that and expect me to remember what I was going to tell you.

garden-laugh.speaker: gabriel
garden-laugh.text: Hey, it floated for almost seven seconds. That’s seven seconds of excellent craftsmanship.

garden-distance.speaker: gabriel
garden-distance.text: Yeah. We were. Funny how some things stay with you, though.

garden-memory.speaker: gabriel
garden-memory.text: You were upset when it sank. So I sat beside you and played that terrible song on my little guitar. Over and over.

garden-song.speaker: player
garden-song.text: It wasn’t terrible. You just only knew three chords.

garden-promise.speaker: gabriel
garden-promise.text: Four now. I’ve been practicing. I never liked seeing you sad, you know.

garden-sunset.text: The afternoon slips into evening. When he suggests visiting your old beach, you find yourself saying yes before he finishes asking.

beach-arrival.text: The world is quieter here. Moonlight gathers on the water, turning each small wave to silver.

beach-confession.speaker: gabriel
beach-confession.text: You know... I think I’ve been wanting to tell you something for a long time.

beach-nerves.text: He looks down at the space between your hands. For once, your always-confident Gubbi seems lost for words.

beach-choice.speaker: player
beach-choice.text: The waves fill the silence. This time, you decide how to meet him in it.

beach-hand.speaker: gabriel
beach-hand.text: Your hand is warm. Sorry. That’s not what I was going to say. You’re making this very difficult, {playerName}.

beach-time.speaker: gabriel
beach-time.text: You always know how to make the world a little less frightening. Thank you for that.

beach-friend.speaker: gabriel
beach-friend.text: Always. Whatever comes next, I want you to know that part doesn’t change.

romantic-confession.speaker: gabriel
romantic-confession.text: I love you, {playerName}. Not just because we grew up together. Because every day, I keep choosing you.

romantic-answer.speaker: player
romantic-answer.text: Then keep choosing me. I think my heart’s been doing the same thing.

romantic-promise.speaker: gabriel
romantic-promise.text: Okay. But just so you know... I’m still building you that boat.

romantic-close.text: His fingers find yours. The ocean stretches ahead, wide and unknown. For the first time, the promise feels like a beginning.

romantic-ending.kicker: ENDING 01 · A HEART FINDS ITS HOME
romantic-ending.title: It was always you.
romantic-ending.text: Some love stories begin with a stranger. Yours began with a childhood promise, and a hand you never wanted to let go.

bittersweet-confession.speaker: gabriel
bittersweet-confession.text: I think a part of me has loved you for a long time. You don’t have to say it back. I just wanted to be honest, for once.

bittersweet-answer.speaker: player
bittersweet-answer.text: Gubbi... I care about you so much. I’m just not sure my heart is in the same place yet.

bittersweet-promise.speaker: gabriel
bittersweet-promise.text: Then we don’t have to rush it. You’re still my favorite person to watch the sea with.

bittersweet-close.text: You sit beside him until the tide comes in. Some things have changed. Some things, you hope, never will.

bittersweet-ending.title: Beneath the same moon.
bittersweet-ending.text: Not every feeling finds its answer tonight. But there is still a place beside him, and a little light on the water.
